# Sync Race Studios

> Websites and practical software for independent businesses. Hand-built, fast, and handed over — clients own their files, domain, and accounts from the start.

Work is hand-written HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with Node.js and PostgreSQL behind it. No page builders, no monthly platform lock-in, no tracking scripts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.srcs.online/): What the studio does, recent work, and how a project runs.
- [Software](https://www.srcs.online/pages/codestudio): Custom reporting tools and lightweight business software.
- [Websites](https://www.srcs.online/pages/creativestudio): Websites designed and built end to end.
- [How we work](https://www.srcs.online/pages/manifesto): Why the studio builds without subscriptions or middlemen.
- [Get in touch](https://www.srcs.online/pages/contact): Contact form for project enquiries.
- [Playground](https://www.srcs.online/pages/arcade): Browser experiments and canvas toys.

## Projects

- Stayntouch reporting engine: A reporting layer over the Stayntouch hotel property management system. Pulls occupancy, revenue, and housekeeping figures on a schedule so managers aren't exporting by hand each morning. Node.js and PostgreSQL. Running in production.
- Freelancer OS: A lightweight tool for solo freelancers covering clients, current deliverables, and invoices, without the bulk of a sales CRM. Plain HTML, Alpine.js, and Node. In active development.
